newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-POLISH SQUAD TO FACE ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLISH SQUAD TO FACE ENGLAND.

text.p: Polish coach Antoni Piechniczek on Sunday announced a 19-man squad for their World Cup European group two qualifying match against England at Wembley on Wednesday.
The squad, due to fly to England on Monday, is:
Goalkeepers: Maciej Szczesny (Widzew Lodz), Andrzej Woznikak (FC Porto);

Defenders: Pawel Wojtala (Widzew Lodz), Jacek Zielinski (Legia Warszawa), Adam Ledwon and Kazimierz Wegrzyn (GKS Katowice), Tomasz Hajto (Gornik Zabrze), Pawel Skrzypek (Rakow Czestochowa), Marek Jozwiak (Guingamp), Tomasz Waldoch (VFL Bochum).
Midfielders: Radoslaw Michalski (Widzew Lodz), Ryszard Staniek (Legia Warszawa), Piotr Nowak (TSV 1860 Munich), Jerzy Brzeczek (FC Tirol Innsbruch).
Forwards: Marek Citko (Widzew Lodz), Cezary Kucharski (Legia Warszawa), Marek Saganowski (Feyenoord Rotterdam), Krzysztof Warzycha (Panathinaikos), Henryk Baluszynski (VFL Bochum).
